response.sql:
WITH per_transaction AS (
  SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY transref
),
kept AS (
  SELECT transref, avg_anlycount
  FROM per_transaction
  WHERE avg_anlycount > (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) FROM per_transaction)
),
scored AS (
  SELECT transref,
         avg_anlycount,
         avg_anlycount - (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) FROM per_transaction) AS above_overall_avg,
         avg_anlycount - (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) FROM kept) AS above_kept_avg
  FROM kept
)
SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, above_overall_avg, above_kept_avg
FROM scored
ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each transaction’s average is computed from its sentiment rows; SQLite AVG ignores NULL anlycount values, and transactions whose anlycount values are all NULL have a NULL average and are excluded by the above-average filter.
